dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Is this your desk?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ɪz ðɪs jʊr ˈdɛsk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. My book is on it.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. maɪ ˈbʊk ɪz ˈɑːn ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh, sorry! I'm new in this class.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈsɑːri! aɪm ˈnuː ɪn ðɪs ˈklæs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No problem. Welcome to the class!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈprɑːbləm. ˈwɛlkəm tə ðə ˈklæs!
